samples.title: Thói quen đi bộ
samples.prompt: Develop a talk about walking as a daily habit. Use these ideas: practical benefits, possible difficulties, and ways to improve the experience. Then answer the follow-up questions.
requirementsVi: Lợi ích: people can include gentle movement in ordinary routines.
Khó khăn: some routes are difficult to use.
Cải thiện: keep pavements clear and improve practical walking routes.
samples.summaryVi: Đi bộ dễ thành thói quen khi đường tới nơi cần đến thuận tiện và không bị cản trở.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: I would like to talk about walking as a daily habit. In my opinion, this topic is worth considering because it can affect ordinary decisions and experiences. I will look at a practical benefit, a possible difficulty and a way to make the approach work better.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giới thiệu chủ đề và ba nhánh sẽ triển khai.

paragraphs.label: Ý 1 — lợi ích thực tế
paragraphs.text: First, people can include gentle movement in ordinary routines. This is possible because a useful route to a shop or bus stop can make walking part of a journey rather than an extra task. For example, a resident can walk to a nearby market instead of taking a motorbike for a very short trip. That example shows how an idea can be useful in a real situation. People are more likely to value an approach when they can see what it changes in their own lives.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đi bộ dễ thành thói quen khi đường tới nơi cần đến thuận tiện và không bị cản trở.

paragraphs.label: Ý 2 — khó khăn
paragraphs.text: However, some routes are difficult to use. One reason is that uneven paths, missing crossings and parked vehicles can create barriers. For instance, a parent with a pushchair may have to step into the road because the pavement is blocked. I do not think this means we should reject the whole idea. It means that we need to understand the needs of the people involved before expecting the same result for everyone.
paragraphs.noteVi: Một trở ngại → lý do → ví dụ; tránh khẳng định tuyệt đối.

paragraphs.label: Ý 3 — cách cải thiện
paragraphs.text: A useful step would be to keep pavements clear and improve practical walking routes. To be more specific, a local group could identify one important route to the market and report the barriers along it. I would start with a small trial and ask the people involved what helped and what remained difficult. Their feedback could then guide the next step, so that effort goes towards a real need.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải pháp cụ thể → cách thực hiện → phản hồi.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: To sum up, I think the potential benefit is valuable, but practical planning matters. We should keep the useful parts, recognise the difficulties and make changes when necessary. That would be more helpful than assuming that one approach suits everybody.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt quan điểm, không thêm luận điểm mới.

questions.question: Should everyone follow the same approach to walking as a daily habit?
questions.answer: No, I do not think so. People have different needs and resources. For example, a parent with a pushchair may have to step into the road because the pavement is blocked. A flexible approach would give that person a better chance to benefit.
questions.noteVi: Quan điểm → khác biệt nhu cầu → ví dụ.

questions.question: Who should help address the difficulty you mentioned?
questions.answer: The people organising the activity should listen to those taking part. They could keep pavements clear and improve practical walking routes. Participants should also explain what is difficult instead of assuming that organisers already know.
questions.noteVi: Nêu vai trò của cả người tổ chức và người tham gia.

questions.question: How could we tell whether a new approach is successful?
questions.answer: We could ask whether it solves the original problem and makes daily life easier. Here, we would want to see whether people can include gentle movement in ordinary routines. I would compare people's experiences before and after a small trial rather than judge success by popularity alone.
questions.noteVi: Tiêu chí đo → áp dụng chủ đề → cách so sánh.

paragraphs.label: Ý 1 — lợi ích thực tế
paragraphs.text: First, travellers can spend less of a short break on transport. This is possible because a nearby destination leaves more time for rest and activities at the place itself. For example, a family can take a morning bus to a nearby town and still have most of the day to explore. That example shows how an idea can be useful in a real situation. People are more likely to value an approach when they can see what it changes in their own lives.

paragraphs.label: Ý 1 — lợi ích thực tế

For example, a resident can ask a neighbour to receive a parcel after meeting them at a building event. That example shows how an idea can be useful in a real situation. People are more likely to value an approach when they can see what it changes in their own lives.

paragraphs.text: However, some people may feel pressured to join activities. One reason is that residents have different schedules and preferences about privacy. For instance, a person who works night shifts may not want to attend a loud weekend gathering. I do not think this means we should reject the whole idea. It means that we need to understand the needs of the people involved before expecting the same result for everyone.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: I would like to talk about reading for pleasure. In my opinion, this topic is worth considering because it can affect ordinary decisions and experiences. I will look at a practical benefit, a possible difficulty and a way to make the approach work better.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giới thiệu chủ đề và ba nhánh sẽ triển khai.

paragraphs.label: Ý 1 — lợi ích thực tế
paragraphs.text: First, people can discover ideas and enjoy quiet time away from daily pressure. This is possible because a shared recommendation can help someone find a book they would not choose alone. For example, a reader can try a short story suggested by a neighbour and later discuss a favourite character. That example shows how an idea can be useful in a real situation. People are more likely to value an approach when they can see what it changes in their own lives.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đọc giải trí cần lựa chọn phù hợp và tham gia linh hoạt để không biến thành áp lực hoàn thành chỉ tiêu.

paragraphs.label: Ý 2 — khó khăn
paragraphs.text: However, a formal reading target may remove the enjoyment. One reason is that people read at different speeds and have different amounts of free time. For instance, a busy worker may leave a book group because finishing a long novel every week feels like homework. I do not think this means we should reject the whole idea. It means that we need to understand the needs of the people involved before expecting the same result for everyone.

paragraphs.label: Ý 3 — cách cải thiện

I would start with a small trial and ask the people involved what helped and what remained difficult. Their feedback could then guide the next step, so that effort goes towards a real need.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: I would like to talk about planning everyday spending. In my opinion, this topic is worth considering because it can affect ordinary decisions and experiences. I will look at a practical benefit, a possible difficulty and a way to make the approach work better.

paragraphs.label: Ý 1 — lợi ích thực tế
paragraphs.text: First, people can see whether their income covers essential needs. This is possible because a simple record makes small repeated purchases easier to notice. For example, a student can compare spending on transport, food and online orders before deciding where to cut back. That example shows how an idea can be useful in a real situation. People are more likely to value an approach when they can see what it changes in their own lives.

paragraphs.label: Ý 2 — khó khăn
paragraphs.text: However, a strict plan can fail when unexpected costs appear. One reason is that real life includes repairs, travel changes and other expenses that are hard to predict. It means that we need to understand the needs of the people involved before expecting the same result for everyone.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: I would like to talk about making time for hobbies. In my opinion, this topic is worth considering because it can affect ordinary decisions and experiences. I will look at a practical benefit, a possible difficulty and a way to make the approach work better.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giới thiệu chủ đề và ba nhánh sẽ triển khai.

paragraphs.label: Ý 1 — lợi ích thực tế
paragraphs.text: First, a hobby can provide a break from work and routine responsibilities. This is possible because an activity chosen for enjoyment gives people something to look forward to. For example, an office worker can spend one evening each week learning to draw with a small local group. That example shows how an idea can be useful in a real situation. People are more likely to value an approach when they can see what it changes in their own lives.
paragraphs.noteVi: Sở thích giúp đổi nhịp sống; nên bắt đầu nhỏ, vừa túi tiền và không so mình với người đã giỏi.

paragraphs.label: Ý 2 — khó khăn
paragraphs.text: However, an ambitious hobby plan can become another source of pressure. One reason is that expensive equipment and demanding goals may make a beginner feel unsuccessful. For instance, someone may stop practising music after trying to learn several difficult pieces in the first week. I do not think this means we should reject the whole idea. It means that we need to understand the needs of the people involved before expecting the same result for everyone.
